claims.claim: Suggest Changes Action takes changes from working directory using git diff and applies them as suggested changes in PR review
claims.quote: takes changes from the working directory (using `git diff`) and applies them as suggested changes

claims.claim: Action gives contributors opportunity to review and accept automated changes
claims.quote: Gives contributors an opportunity to review and accept automated changes

claims.claim: Enables semi-automated changes to pull requests without needing PAT or GitHub App installation token to trigger workflow runs
claims.quote: Enables semi-automated changes to pull requests without needing to use a personal access token (PAT)

claims.claim: Action works on pull_request and pull_request_target events
Suggested changes can only be applied to files and lines that are part of the pull request diff
claims.quote: can only be applied to files and lines that are part of the pull request diff

claims.claim: Suggested changes are limited to 3000 files per pull request
claims.quote: limited to 3000 files per pull request

claims.claim: GitHub limits each review to 100 comments
claims.quote: GitHub currently limits each review to 100 comments

claims.claim: Using REQUEST_CHANGES blocks pull request from being merged until review is dismissed or reviewer approves
claims.quote: will block the pull request from being merged until the review is dismissed or the same reviewer approves

claims.claim: Default GITHUB_TOKEN has read-only permissions for pull requests from forks
claims.quote: GITHUB_TOKEN has read-only permissions for pull requests from forks

claims.claim: Action is not certified by GitHub
Using pull_request_target runs workflow in context of base repository
claims.quote: workflow runs in the context of the base repository

claims.claim: Running untrusted code in pull_request_target context can lead to repository compromise and secret exposure
claims.quote: can lead to security vulnerabilities including repository compromise and secret exposure

claims.claim: If rate limits exceeded, action logs warning with reset time and stops processing
claims.quote: will log a warning with the reset time when available and stop processing

claims.claim: If changes generate more than 100 suggestions, action posts first 100 and explains additional may be posted later
claims.quote: will post the first 100 suggestions and explain that additional suggestions may be posted on future workflow runs
